The '''Mudflats''' were marshes and swamps on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], one of the [[Double Worlds]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SWG" /> They were notable to geologists not only for their vast size&mdash;some stretching thousands of kilometers, but for the whole ecologies that existed within. They were home to the dangerous predatory [[sludge panther]].<ref name="SoF" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a spacer retrieved a piece of [[Rebel assault armor]] in the Mudflats.<ref name="SWG:LRAAC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Lost Rebel Assault Armor Collection}}</ref>

[[File:Talus_Mud_Flats_SOF.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in the Mudflats.]]

==Behind the scenes==
The Mudflats were one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
